meta.name: game-concept
meta.description: Design game concepts from a novel. From SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF, generate three genuinely different directions on the dimensions still unlocked, then pick the most worthwhile playable prototype using hard vetoes and explicit trade-offs. Use for what game should this novel become, compare game concepts, choose a game direction for this book, decide whether this novel should become an interactive story. 小说游戏概念设计。根据 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 在未锁定维度上生成三个真正不同的方案，用硬否决和关键取舍选择最值得做的可玩原型。用于判断小说适合做成什么游戏、该不该做成互动叙事、比较游戏方案等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从小说出发生成三个游戏概念方案，用硬否决与取舍选出最值得做的可玩原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手里有本小说，想判断它适合做成什么样的游戏或是否值得做成互动叙事
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel and want to decide what game it should become or whether it should be an interactive story

howto.what: Claude 会阅读你提供的小说原文和产品简报，先检查材料是否齐全，然后提出三个不同的游戏方向，淘汰明显不合适的，挑一个最值得先做试玩版的，最后写一份游戏概念文档。
howto.when: 当你提供了小说原文和产品简报，并问这本小说适合做成什么游戏、比较不同游戏概念，或决定要不要做成互动叙事时触发。

say.text: 我上传了小说原文和产品简报，请生成三个游戏方向。
say.note: 会先检查两份材料是否齐全，再出三个方案。

say.text: 从这三个方案里选一个最值得做试玩版的方向。
say.note: 会用硬否决和取舍来选，并说明理由。

say.text: 这本小说适合做成互动叙事游戏吗？
say.note: 会评估是否适合，并说明判断依据。

howto.what_en: Claude reads your novel text and product brief, checks that both are present, proposes three different game concepts, eliminates unsuitable ones, picks the most promising playable prototype, and writes a game concept document.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask what game this novel should become, compare game concepts, or decide whether to make it an interactive story.

say_en.text: I've uploaded the novel text and product brief. Generate three game directions.
say_en.note: It will check that both files are present first.

say_en.text: Pick the most worthwhile direction from these three for a playable prototype.
say_en.note: It uses vetoes and trade-offs to choose and explains why.

say_en.text: Should this novel become an interactive story?
say_en.note: It evaluates suitability and gives its reasoning.
